title: The Backpack
lines: Tom and Dan go to camp with Dad and Dan's kitten.
Tom packs his backpack with a hotdog and napkin.
They hop up the big hill to the camp.
At the top Tom sets his backpack on the grass.
Tom and Dan help Dad set up the tent.
The kitten slips into the backpack!
At sunset Tom digs for his hotdog.
The kitten is sitting on it! Tom is upset.
The hotdog is a mess. The napkin is wet.
Dad hands him a muffin and Tom grins.
The kitten naps as the sun sets.

questions.listenFor: A hotdog and a napkin. Then the kitten slips in too. Stated in the story — have them find the lines instead of listing it for them.
The kitten sat on his hotdog and made it a mess. If they only say "the kitten," ask "and what did the kitten do?"

questions.ask: How did Tom feel when he found the kitten on his hotdog? Which word tells you?
questions.listenFor: Upset — line eight says so. Then Dad hands him a muffin and he grins, which turns it round.
